Map the Route** | Use a navigation app (Google Maps, Waze, Apple Maps) to plot the most efficient highway path. For a straight‑line estimate, you can call `estimate_distance` with the zip codes of Rivermist and San Francisco. | Gives you the total mileage and major interstates (I‑80, I‑5, etc.). | | **2. Check Fuel Needs** | Once you have the distance, estimate how many gallons you’ll need. Plan Refueling Stops** | Identify service stations along the way—especially on I‑80/5. Prepare Your Vehicle** | • Check tire pressure (`check_tire_pressure`).
• Verify engine status (`startEngine` with `"START"`).
• Set cruise control if you prefer a steady pace (`setCruiseControl`). | Ensures safety and smooth driving. | | **5. Manage Climate & Comfort** | • Set cabin temperature to a comfortable level (`adjustClimateControl`).
• Lock/unlock doors as needed (`lockDoors`). | Keeps you comfortable and secure during the drive. | | **6. Monitor Weather** | Get the outside temperature from reliable sources (`get_outside_temperature_from_google` or `get_outside_temperature_from_weather_com`). | Helps you adjust heating/cooling and anticipate road conditions. | | **7. Keep Track of Time & Distance** | Use `get_current_speed` to monitor average speed and estimate arrival time. | Allows you to stay on schedule and avoid traffic delays. | | **8. Stay Informed** | Display key statuses like fuel level (`displayCarStatus` with `"fuel"`) and battery health (`displayCarStatus` with `"battery"`). | Keeps you aware of critical vehicle metrics. | ### Quick Example Using the Tools ```python # Estimate distance distance_result = estimate_distance(cityA="Rivermist", cityB="San Francisco") print(distance_result) # Check tire pressure tire_status = check_tire_pressure() print(tire_status) ``` Feel free to plug in actual values (zip codes, mpg, etc.) into the corresponding functions above to get precise numbers. Safe travels!
